title: Keyboard manager breaks alt-scroll in Adobe Photosop & Illustrator

status.label: Isolate the F9 media remap from Adobe zoom scrolling
status.detail: The report uses PowerToys 0.99.1, maps F9 to Play/Pause, and also runs Logi Options+; no comparison establishes which component blocks Alt-scroll.

judgment.rationale: The report says Alt-scroll/scroll-to-zoom stops working in Photoshop and Illustrator while Keyboard Manager is enabled with F9 mapped to Play/Pause, and Logi Options+ is also installed. The report is from 0.99.1 and does not say whether removing the F9 mapping or disabling Keyboard Manager restores zoom. Current Keyboard Manager installs a keyboard hook; its mouse hook is only enabled for alone-key remaps, so a direct mouse-wheel interaction is not established by the reported F9 mapping. Ask for the minimal isolation test before attributing the issue to PowerToys.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.99.1, Windows 11, Logitech MX Keys, Photoshop and Illustrator, and Logi Options+.
F9 is remapped to Play/Pause; Alt-scroll/scroll-to-zoom reportedly stops working in the Adobe apps.
The report has no comments or assignees and provides no test with the F9 mapping removed or Logi Options+ disabled.
The current Keyboard Manager installs a mouse hook only for alone-key remaps; the reported F9-to-media mapping does not itself establish a mouse-hook path.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether Adobe zoom scrolling works on v0.102.3001 after removing only the F9 mapping, and whether the same behavior changes when Logi Options+ is disabled.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys/Logi/Adobe interaction is possible, but the report does not establish that the F9 mapping causes the mouse-scroll failure.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Adobe zoom scrolling with the F9 media-key mapping
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The F9-to-Play/Pause mapping may interact with Logi Options+ or Adobe input handling, but the issue lacks a control test and the reported keyboard mapping does not establish a mouse-event path.
plan: Retest Alt-scroll/scroll-to-zoom on v0.102.3001 with the reported F9-to-Play/Pause mapping.
Remove only the F9 mapping and repeat the same Adobe zoom gesture.
If the mapping changes the result, compare with Logi Options+ disabled to isolate the interaction before tracing code.
verification: Confirm Adobe zoom scrolling works with and without the F9 mapping under the same setup.
Verify the media-key remap still works when restored and does not interfere with ordinary scroll behavior.

confidence.rationale: The report is from 0.99.1 and has no control test; both Logi Options+ and Adobe-specific scroll behavior are plausible confounders.

issue_context.summary: Alt-scroll/scroll-to-zoom reportedly stops working in Photoshop and Illustrator while Keyboard Manager maps F9 to Play/Pause and Logi Options+ is installed.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.99.1, Windows 11, Logitech MX Keys, Photoshop/Illustrator, and Logi Options+.
Keyboard Manager maps F9 to Play/Pause.
The reporter says Alt-scroll or scroll-to-zoom stops working in the Adobe apps.
No comments or comparisons with the F9 mapping removed are available.
inferences: The symptom may be an interaction between Keyboard Manager, Logi Options+, and Adobe input handling; the current evidence does not establish a causal link.
issue_context.analysis: The first test should remove only the F9 mapping and retry the same Adobe gesture, then compare Logi Options+ if the mapping changes the result. This avoids requesting generic logs before verifying whether the keyboard remap is causal.
initial_investigation: Read the full report, labels, comments, and setup details.
Inspected Keyboard Manager hook setup: the mouse hook is synchronized only when alone-key remaps exist; the reported F9 media mapping does not establish that it is intercepting mouse scroll.
Searched for other matching Photoshop/Illustrator Alt-scroll reports with Keyboard Manager; no separate matching issue was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether Alt-scroll/zoom works on v0.102.3001 when the F9-to-Play/Pause mapping is removed, and whether Logi Options+ changes the result
information_gaps.why_needed: The report includes multiple input components and no control test, so the cause cannot yet be attributed to Keyboard Manager.

If the result changes, please say whether disabling Logi Options+ changes it too.
